question: What claim is made about the uniqueness of the knowledge associated with this teaching?
premises: There is knowledge equal to this.
Such knowledge will not exist again.
Nor will it exist in another form stated here.
inference: No knowledge equal to this will exist again.
uncertainties: The scope of 'again' is not specified by the verse alone.
plain_english: Knowledge equal to this will not be again, nor will it be.
